description: This file contains utility functions related to throughput data processing, including formatting data rates, calculating data rates from cumulative byte counters, formatting timestamps, preparing chart data, determining appropriate Y-axis units, and converting data rates. It is specifically tailored for throughput visualization and analysis within the project.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts bytes per second into a human-readable data rate with appropriate units (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates data rate (rx and tx) from current and previous cumulative byte counters over a given interval, accounting for counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a UNIX timestamp into a HH:MM:SS string suitable for chart labels.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares labels and datasets for chart visualization from a series of throughput data points, limiting to maxPoints.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the appropriate unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for the Y-axis based on maximum data rate in a dataset.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts a data rate from bytes per second to a specified unit for display consistency.

ctags.name: convertToUnit
